checks.value: The plotted FFT phase-grid envelopes and finite Fourier-lattice ODE roots are deterministic finite diagnostics. They corroborate, but do not prove, the infinite-lattice perturbative theorem. The mixed-exposure curve is a truncated grid proxy with a declared analytic tail bound. No interval arithmetic, PDE DNS, Navier-Stokes singularity, regularity theorem, or Millennium-problem solution is claimed.
